about: Cross-org operations: PERMAFLEET itself plus its squadrons (entries with a `body`, shown on the PERMAFLEET page), and the Discord channels each operation's metrics count. `body` is trusted HTML. Channel matchers: a channel id, an exact name, or "/regex/" on the name (@fabric/discord functions/channelMatcher).

operations.name: ALPHA SQUADRON
operations.role: Elite fighters · run by G00N SQUAD
operations.body: The tip of the spear for PERMAFLEET, drawn from the top of BRAVO SQUADRON. Applications are open below. Signing up is also how you join G00N SQUAD, even if you’re already in PERMAFLEET.
operations.summary: The tip of the spear for PERMAFLEET, drawn from the top of BRAVO SQUADRON. Applications are open.
